sharedHostWriters: This lane was the only writer on scripts/build-census-v1-wa_blake_vacatur_and_lfo_refund-set.mjs.
preflight: Master Library restored from the pinned release asset; archive sha256 matches the pin. verify-packet-build-environment.mjs: master_library_mounted ok, master_library_complete ok (501 files, 329 PDFs, 51 jurisdictions), corpus_matches_committed_index ok (24 sampled entries byte-exact), family_sources_bind ok 2/2 by exact SHA-256.
laneSummary: One correction to one shared host repaired the same defect in all seven families. The host used to end its participant instructions with a sentence that named no court, no fee, no waiver route, no service recipient and no method, and that told the participant the route controls recorded as unresolved three facts those controls record. It now derives the three obligations from the committed route obligation census, the committed worklist and the route's own pinned official instruction sheet: it STATES the filing destination and the service recipient, method and timing, because the repository holds them, and for the filing fee and any waiver route it states that nothing held answers the question and names the clerk of the stated court. Not one fee figure was invented, and the searches that found nothing are recorded per family with what was found and why it does not answer this route. Two families are held on route-election legal inputs this lane found and recorded rather than repaired away, and one on the fact that its route's own official instruments are not pinned.

theTwoControlFamilies.whyTheyAreHere: Both import the same host and neither is this lane's to move. Both were rebuilt off the corrected host and their rendered PDF artifact SHA-256s were recomputed from disk and compared to the committed reports/rendered-artifacts.json.
theTwoControlFamilies.result: UNCHANGED. All eight PDF artifacts across the two families hash identically before and after. wa_vac_felony-set's hash-bound raster receipt still binds: its pinned canonical and boundary PDFs hash to the bytes on disk, and its queue row remains RASTER_PASS.
theTwoControlFamilies.whatDidChangeForThem: Their participant-facing records only: participant-completion-instructions.json, build-findings.json and a new filing-obligations.json. Their verified state is untouched and this lane does not restate it.

rasterPngDrift.finding: Rebuilding on this runner reproduces every PDF byte-for-byte but re-renders some raster PNGs differently: same dimensions, same DPI, roughly 8% of pixel bytes differing at glyph edges. It affects the seven repaired families and neither control.
rasterPngDrift.provedEnvironmental: Reproduced with the UNMODIFIED host at the base commit before any edit was kept, so it is this runner's Poppler (pdftoppm 24.02.0), not this repair.
rasterPngDrift.whatWasDone: The re-rendered PNGs and the raster rows of reports/rendered-artifacts.json were discarded and the committed bytes restored, so the branch keeps exactly the pixels the visual gate proved. Committing them would have churned 74 receipts for no change in what the packet delivers.
rasterPngDrift.forCaptain: Worth pinning the rasterizer version the way the corpus is pinned, or the next lane on a different runner will silently rewrite receipts.

boundariesRaisedNotDecided.question: Does an official instruction sheet that the family does not BIND, but that is pinned by SHA-256 in the committed corpus index, count as held under DET-FEE-AND-WAIVER-001-A2?
boundariesRaisedNotDecided.whyItMatters: SERVICE method and timing for all nine families rests on it. A2's whatCountsAsHeld lists the bound sources, the compiled profile, the track registry, the packet-set manifest and anything the route census names as a requiredSourceId. CrRLJ 09.0300 and CR 08.0930 are none of those by name, but they are the court system's own instructions for these exact routes, they are pinned in the committed corpus index, and this lane re-hashed their bytes before quoting them.
boundariesRaisedNotDecided.whatThisLaneDid: Treated them as held and said so in the open, in every filing-obligations.json. If Captain reads A2's list as closed, SERVICE method and timing on all nine falls back to naming the clerk, which is a one-line change to one function in the host and no change to any packet byte.

boundariesRaisedNotDecided.question: wa_vac_treaty_fishing-set's worklist records that its route reaches felonies as well as misdemeanours, so the destination may be a superior court. The family binds the CrRLJ courts-of-limited-jurisdiction forms and this lane therefore cites the CrRLJ instruction sheet for its service rule.
boundariesRaisedNotDecided.whyItMatters: Under A3 the CrRLJ sheet does not answer a superior-court felony filing. The packet's stated service rule is right for the misdemeanour case and unestablished for the felony case.
boundariesRaisedNotDecided.whatThisLaneDid: Recorded it here and in the family's route-options-block.json rather than papering it over. It is one more reason the family is held.

whatCouldNotBeEstablished: No court filing fee and no fee-waiver route for any of the seven routes. Nothing in the bound forms, the official instruction sheets, the compiled Washington profile, the state pack or the committed worklist states one. The state pack calls it a source gap in those words. This lane did not close it and did not pretend to.
Whether CrRLJ 09.0100's printed grounds reach RCW 9.96.060(4), (6) or (7). Three families turn on it and it is a counsel question.
Whether CR 09.0500/09.0600/09.0700 can be acquired as official PDFs. They exist in the corpus only as revision-UNKNOWN .doc files outside the committed index.
The raster PNG receipts themselves were not read; this lane checked the receipt chain and the hash binding, not the pixels.
grantsNothing: A repair is not a promotion. No family here is proven, no route is opened, and the four PASS verdicts are a repairer's reading awaiting an independent one.

FEE_AND_WAIVER.evidence: NOT HELD, so a NAMED CHECKABLE AUTHORITY stands in, per A1 as widened by A2 and bounded by A3. Searched: both bound sources (money language measured at build time from their content streams: 0 lines each); CrRLJ 09.0300, Instructions for Vacating Misdemeanor and Gross Misdemeanor Convictions (07/2022), sha256 42ac9ccb16474172ee3b4076b416e9d949c2dfdbb43edc0cdc734eca299f4176 (0 money lines, measured at build time); the compiled WA profile, whose only fee statements are Washington State Patrol criminal-history record charges ($11 WATCH, $32 mail CHRI, $58 fingerprint card, +$15 notarized, +$12 non-conviction copy, no fee in person) — a different transaction, so A3 bars reading them as this route's filing fee; src/lib/rcap/state-packs/washington/fee-notes.ts, which records the gap explicitly; and the committed worklist, where filingFee and feeWaiverTreatment are both not_recorded. Named instead: Clerk of the sentencing district or municipal court, the clerk's office of the court stated under FILING_DESTINATION, answering whether a fee applies, the amount, and whether a waiver is available. No amount is stated because none is held.

SERVICE.evidence: Recipient HELD and STATED: the committed worklist records ["Serve the prosecuting attorney for the sentencing court","Serve the prosecutor's office for the sentencing court and file proof of service"]. Method and timing HELD and STATED from the route's own official instruction sheet, CrRLJ 09.0300, Instructions for Vacating Misdemeanor and Gross Misdemeanor Convictions (07/2022), sha256 42ac9ccb16474172ee3b4076b416e9d949c2dfdbb43edc0cdc734eca299f4176, re-hashed against the committed corpus index at build time and quoted verbatim: "On the same day that you file those documents with the clerk of the court, you must also provide a copy of each document (the petition and declaration, and the scheduling notice) to the prosecuting attorney’s office that prosecuted you." No prosecutor directory is carried on this series, because the CrRLJ sheet does not print one and A3 bars importing the felony sheet's. The worklist's serviceMethod and serviceTiming are not_recorded, so before this repair the packet named nothing; the sheet holds both, so an authority does not stand in here.

SELF_HELP_STOP.evidence: participant-instructions.md carries a "Where self-help ends" section: four named stops: wrong route or court, under 21 at the offence or unsure the offence qualifies, prosecutor objection, and any mismatch with the court record. The build now refuses to finish if the committed instructions stop stating any of these four obligations, so the section cannot silently disappear on a rebuild.

whatWasRepaired.before: participant-completion-instructions.json ended with "Confirm local filing, notice, service, fee, and hearing requirements with the sentencing court before filing. The route controls record local variation as unresolved." — the verbatim sentence every verifier matched. whatWasRepaired.after: The host derives FILING_DESTINATION, FEE_AND_WAIVER and SERVICE from the committed route obligation census, the committed worklist and the route's own pinned official instruction sheet, writes them to a new filing-obligations.json, and writes them as participant-facing sentences. One derivation for all nine families; nothing is keyed to a family id and there is no per-family whitelist.
whatWasRepaired.alsoCorrected: build-findings.json carried the same A4 denial in its advisories — it asserted the worklist recorded filing, notice, service, fee and hearing variation as unresolved. It now says which of those the packet states and which is genuinely open.
whatWasRepaired.theSilentForm: The host preserved participant-instructions.md when it existed and wrote none when it did not, so a family could ship no instructions at all and no gate noticed. It now generates one from the same derived data when none exists, and verifies a committed one against the four obligations instead of overwriting it — so an earlier lane's better, source-cited prose survives a rebuild and a rebuild cannot quietly drop an obligation.
whatWasRepaired.whatWasNotInvented: No fee figure, no waiver rule and no service recipient was written that is not read out of a committed record or measured from pinned source bytes in this run. Where nothing is held, the packet says nothing is held and names an office.
